name: SwiftData iCloud sync
description: Syncs the app's SwiftData store across the user's devices through their private iCloud database, with the entitlements and background mode it needs.

cost.note: Needs a paid Apple Developer Program membership for the iCloud container; CloudKit usage within Apple's free allowance has no extra charge

amounts.label: Apple Developer Program membership (needed to distribute; not needed for simulator builds)

usage: Create the container with `PersistenceController.syncedContainer(for: [Order.self, ...])` instead of `container(for:)`. Every @Model property needs a default value or must be optional, relationships must be optional, and `@Attribute(.unique)` is not allowed. Previews keep using `PersistenceController.preview(for:)` (local, in memory).
statusNote: Swift compiled on a Mac in the combined compile check (see compileCheck); the module's own verify run has not passed yet: `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify swiftdata-cloudkit-sync` on a Mac.

compileCheck.scope: Template Swift and the verify usage file compiled with every other module in one app target (scripts/capability-compile-check.mjs, clean build in Xcode). Not covered: the XcodeGen project, entitlements, the widget extension target and runtime behavior.
